MERIDIAN COMFORT CLUB TERMS AND CONDITIONS

California, as published August 2026

Published at: https://www.meridianpha.com/ca/comfort-club-terms

1. PROGRAM DESCRIPTION

Upon enrollment in Meridian Comfort Club, you authorize the receipt of text messages (SMS/MMS) to your registered mobile telephone number. These messages may include responses to your service inquiries and estimate requests, real-time communications regarding our available services and pricing information, appointment scheduling and confirmation notices, customer satisfaction surveys, service status updates, and follow-up communications. Your phone numbers and opt-in data will not be shared with third parties for marketing purposes.

2. MESSAGE FREQUENCY

The frequency of messages will vary depending on the type and nature of each communication.

3. CANCELLATION AND RE-ENROLLMENT

You may cancel your participation in Meridian Comfort Club at any time by texting "STOP" to the designated phone number. Upon receipt of your cancellation message, you will receive an SMS confirmation acknowledging your withdrawal from the program. You will not receive SMS or MMS messages from Meridian following this confirmation. Should you wish to re-enroll, you may do so through the original enrollment process or by texting "START," at which time message delivery will resume.

4. CUSTOMER SUPPORT

If you need assistance or encounter technical difficulties, you may reply to any message with the keyword "HELP" or contact Meridian directly through our customer service channels.

5. WIRELESS CARRIER LIABILITY

Meridian shall not be responsible for message delivery failures. Wireless carriers and mobile network operators disclaim any liability for delayed messages, undelivered messages, or any transmission errors.

6. MESSAGE AND DATA CHARGES

Standard message and data rates from your wireless carrier may apply to all SMS and MMS messages sent to and from Meridian. You are responsible for all such charges under your wireless service plan. For questions regarding your plan's messaging rates or data charges, please contact your wireless service provider.

7. PRIVACY PROTECTION

Your personal information is handled in accordance with Meridian's Privacy Policy. Please consult our Privacy Policy for information regarding how we collect, use, and protect your personal data.
